page_title: INT 3-2 MON | Inter v Monza 08/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Stefan Lekovic (Monza) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

90+2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Inter are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
86' Alessandro Nesta has decided to make a change. Arvid Brorsson (Monza) replaces Armando Izzo.
86' Samuele Birindelli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Vignato (Monza).
84' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared.

84' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
84' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
83' What a chance that is! Marcus Thuram (Inter) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
82' Monza are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
77' 3 - 2 Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) was unlucky to score an own goal attempting to intercept a cross. Hang your head in shame!
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is coming onto the pitch as Keita Balde cannot continue after picking up an injury.

76' Nice move, nice attempt! Marcus Thuram (Inter) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
74' The attendance for today's match is 66334.
73' Keita Balde (Monza) takes a short corner kick.
73' Simone Inzaghi is forced to make a change. Piotr Zielinski is unable to continue due to injury, Joaquin Correa (Inter) comes on.
72' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

71' A lofted ball into the centre of the box is met with a forceful header by Marcus Thuram (Inter), but it flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
70' Here is a change. Marko Arnautovic is going off and Simone Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Marcus Thuram (Inter).
70' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Henrikh Mkhitaryan as he is replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
69' Alessandro Nesta appears to have said too much and referee Luca Zufferli comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
67' The substitution is prepared. Stefan Lekovic (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gaetano Castrovilli.
66' Alessandro Nesta prepares a substitution. Dany Mota is replaced by Silvere Ganvoula (Monza).

64' 2 - 2 Nice piece of skill by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter). He perfectly collected a pass from Yann Bisseck and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:2.

63' Denzel Dumfries sends a terrific cross into the box. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
62' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
61' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) blows a clear opportunity! He sends a rebound from close range narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
58' The Inter players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' The game is interrupted now, Samuele Birindelli (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Inter will take a throw-in.
52' Inter show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
51' Inter work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

51' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Stefano Turati thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.

49' Yann Bisseck (Inter) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header would probably have ended up low inside the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off a comfortable save to thwart him.
48' It seemed like Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Simone Inzaghi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Stefan de Vrij (Inter). He is replaced by Carlos Augusto.
46' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Yann Bisseck comes on the pitch for Benjamin Pavard (Inter).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Luca Zufferli signals that the goal stands! The Inter players celebrate.
45+3' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Inter players aren’t happy.
45+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Denzel Dumfries finds Marko Arnautovic (Inter) and he shows great determination to get to the ball and plant a header into the back of the net. 1:2.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' 0 - 2 The defending players give Keita Balde (Monza) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the top right corner. Josep Martinez was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 0:2.

43' A neat pass is well received by Samuele Birindelli (Monza), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
40' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

39' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
38' It's a yellow card for Armando Izzo (Monza).

38' Stefano Turati pulls off a great save to deny Denzel Dumfries (Inter) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!

36' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
36' There's an opportunity for Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

36' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
34' The resulting corner, taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), comes to nothing.
32' 0 - 1 Samuele Birindelli (Monza) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!

32' Nicolo Barella (Inter) controls the ball from the corner kick and unleashes a low drive from the edge of the box towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
31' The referee awards a corner and Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take it.

31' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
31' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
29' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a throw-in.
28' Inter show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
26' The goal by Inter is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
25' Wait! Referee Luca Zufferli has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
24' Lovely goal by Lautaro Martinez (Inter)!
24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

23' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Stefano Turati dived superbly to block a header by Marko Arnautovic (Inter) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Stefano Turati pulled off a remarkable save!

21' What an opportunity! Alessandro Bianco (Monza) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

20' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
20' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner.
19' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
19' Gaetano Castrovilli (Monza) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Zufferli no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Inter.
17' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
16' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Keita Balde (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
14' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
11' A long ball forward to Marko Arnautovic (Inter) is intercepted.
9' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes it short.

9' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Inter are going to take it.

7' Keita Balde (Monza) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
3' Monza are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
2' That's unlucky! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Monza will kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
